_meta.purpose: Maps a Bison lead's niche variable to the Consulti search that builds their give-first list.
_meta.source: The 40 resolvable niche values found on the 56 interested leads across Bison campaigns 1298, 1313, 1315, 1145 (Consulti workspace).

classes.industry: Maps to a Consulti industries[] filter. Pre-build one 300-row CSV per entry.
classes.geo: No industry. Needs the lead's own city/state. Built per-lead from /local-leads/search.
classes.intent: A buying signal, not an industry. Consulti has no filter for it. Do NOT auto-send; ask the lead what industry their clients are in.

_meta.local_params: /local-leads/search takes keywords[] (not categories[]), states[] as 2-letter codes only, cities[], hasEmail, page, size. No native exclusion; dedupe on google_place_id client-side.
_meta.routing_rule: Local brick-and-mortar business types go to /local-leads/search with Google Maps category keywords; the LinkedIn industry enum is too loose for them and returns suppliers and national chains. Genuine B2B niches go to /leads/search with empMin/empMax so an agency gets prospects its size, not the Fortune 500.
_meta.local_rows: Local rows carry owner_name, owner_title, website and phone but NO LinkedIn. Rows without an owner_name are dropped so every contact has a real name.

auto dealerships.note: Local DB only. The B2B Automotive industry filter returns tire makers, auto auctions and General Motors; measured 174/300 even auto-related.

law firms.note: Local DB only. B2B Law Practice returns Perkins Coie and Akerman LLP, national firms a small agency cannot sell to.

healthcare companies.note: Read as local practices, which is what an agency's healthcare clients actually are.

home service companies.note: Trades are under-covered in the 500M B2B set.

cannabis brands.note: No Consulti industry enum for cannabis.

financial services firms.note: empMax keeps the national banks out.

marketing & advertising.note: Their clients are other agencies. Confirm this is really the niche and not a mis-enrichment of the lead's OWN industry.

geo._build: Per-lead, not pre-built. Read the lead's city/state from its own enrichment, then /local-leads/search in that metro. Never trust Bison's city/state fields (known bad: city 'England', state 'Arkansas').

b2b businesses.note: Widest possible read. Treat as a clarify case if the lead is high value.

intent._handling: No list is auto-sent for these. The reply asks one question: what industry are the clients you want this for? The answer is then run through the industry map above.
